description: This Java class defines configuration properties for downstream service clients used in a checkout service, including various service endpoints and timeout settings.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties
classes.description: A configuration class holding properties for different downstream services like cart, order, pricing, tax, promotions, inventory, and payment.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties.ServiceClientProperties
classes.description: A nested class representing individual service client configuration including base URL and timeout.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the cart service.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the order service.

methods.name: getPricing
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the pricing service.

methods.name: getTax
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the tax service.

methods.name: getPromotions
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the promotions service.

methods.name: getInventory
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the inventory service.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the payment service.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the service client.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Sets the base URL for the service client.

methods.name: getTimeoutMs
methods.description: Returns the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.

methods.name: setTimeoutMs
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.
